newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan police hold two for Canadian's murder.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan police hold two for Canadian's murder.

text.p: Venezuelan police said Friday they were holding two suspects in connection with the murder of a Canadian found dead on a Caribbean beach with 11 bullet wounds.

Alberto Marquez, 18, and Dionel Diaz, 26, were arrested Thursday for presumed involvement in the killing of Michel Doyon whose bullet-riddled body was found on Margarita island Tuesday, local police chief Luciano Rebolledo said.
Police ruled out theft as a motive as Doyon was still wearing a gold ring and carrying cash in his pocket.
The two suspects knew and may have lived with Doyon, whose body was due to be flown back to Montreal Friday night, Rebolledo said.
A Canadian embassy spokesman in Caracas said Doyon had been living on Margarita island, just off Venezuela's northeast coast, for about a month and a half.
